method: Fresh interpreter and empty case directories per case; actual pinned downloads and generated Arrow inventories; row digest is SHA256 over sorted-key compact UTF-8 JSON rows each followed by newline.
scope: One WSL host; tiny non-streaming Hub CSV dataset and model config only. No model weights, GPU inference, throughput, large-dataset storage ratio or host disk reclaim measurement. Offline check uses library offline flags plus a self-tested Python socket guard, not OS network isolation.
excluded_scouts: scout-v1: six harness KeyError failures from text versus actual review column; scout-v2: six successful preparation cases. Neither counted in the primary matrix.
